title: Acme Logistics: duplicate charge again on invoice 9012
transcript:
Agent: Acme support, this is Maya. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Maya, this is Priya again from Acme Logistics. We have another duplicate charge.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that. Can you give me the invoice number?
Customer: Invoice 9012. This time it is $180. It is the same thing that happened in August, except now it is a different invoice.
Agent: Let me look at the account history. I see the August duplicate on invoice 8841, and the refund we issued for $120. I also see the note about the late fee waiver.
Customer: Yes, that is us. We thought it was fixed. Finance is asking whether we need to change how we pay.
Agent: I understand. The pattern looks the same. I am going to issue a refund for $180 for the duplicate on invoice 9012 and open a billing escalation so someone can check why the second charge keeps appearing.
Customer: How long will the refund take?
Agent: Five to seven business days to the same card. I will send the confirmation to the billing contact.
Customer: And the escalation? Will someone call us?
Agent: I am creating a high-priority ticket with the billing team. They should reach out within two business days. I will include the August ticket and the refund reference so they have the history.
Customer: Okay. Please make sure they know this is the second time. We cannot keep spending time on this.
Agent: I have noted that. The ticket references both invoices and the prior refund. If you do not hear from billing by September 4, call us back and ask for the escalation owner.
Customer: Thank you. I appreciate you pulling up the history.
Agent: Of course. Sorry again for the repeat issue.
